acceptance_criteria:
Milestone Acceptance Criteria:

1. Techstars will review the virtual applications in the following manner:

• Applications meet the eligibility requirement defined in Milestone 1.

• Applications will be assessed according to each startup's potential for success based on idea, team, market size/business model, traction, and how much Techstars believes the program could benefit the startup in alignment with the program’s objectives.

• 25-30 finalists will be selected to proceed to selection committee interviews.


2. A final cohort of startups will be selected to participate in the program via input from the selection committee as a whole and the Techstars program team. Techstars will virtually interview finalist companies that accept our invitation via a selection committee with the following parameters:

• The selection committee will be composed of Techstars team members and experts in the industry.

• Selection Committee will use a standard evaluation framework/scoring system.

*While applicants will be interviewed and scored using the same framework, system, and scoring metrics, it is important to note that evaluation of things like market size or team strength are not fully objective categories. Scoring a company’s projected potential is less like scoring a math test and more like evaluating an art project. One of the reasons that Techstars uses a selection committee framework for finalist scoring is to balance out subjectivity and reduce any singular bias.


3. Cohort Selection and Due Diligence

Techstars will choose a final cohort of program participants and invite them to participate in the program following the parameters below:

• A final cohort of 15-20 (up to 30 if applicant pool is exceptional) startups is selected based on application/interview.

• All participants shall have accepted terms and completed legal due diligence in order to participate.

*Please note that the due diligence Techstars performs as the standard for all of our Founder Catalyst programs is only relevant following a company being extended an invite and is not considered in the selection process. This due diligence does not evaluate tech, but is rather used in confirming legal considerations.

*The companies selected will be announced shortly after the kick-off of the program which will occur during Milestone 4.


4. Techstars will plan content and curriculum to be part of the pre-accelerator program using the following parameters:

• Planning includes a general outline of the curriculum schedule, including a masterclass curriculum that will be delivered, as well as pitch practice sessions.

• Core program planning will include the selection of subject matter topics for masterclasses as well as speakers scheduled for those masterclasses over the course of the program by Techstars.

• Core program will include standard sessions important for early-stage founders in any industry; these include masterclasses such as Customer Discovery/Validation/Product Market Fit, Nailing Your Pitch, Introduction to Venture, etcetera.

• The program might include topical masterclass customizations as helpful according to cohort needs and progress, keeping the benefit of the whole cohort versus individual companies in mind (optional).

*While Techstars is able to provide speakers for all masterclass sessions, we are open to speaker suggestions from the Cardano community on Web 3 related topics if they would like to suggest speakers for our consideration, for up to 3 speaking sessions.


5. For the purpose of supporting participant companies during the program, Techstars will:

• Recruit and assemble a program mentor pool (30-50 experts).

• Ensure mentors included cover a variety of subject matter expertise in areas such as marketing, business development, investment, pitch, and Web 3.

• Onboard mentors to a platform where each mentor will have a mentor card, where founders will be able to read a mentor’s bio and book meetings at the mutual convenience of both parties once the program starts.

* Because mentors are able to spend one on one time with the companies in the cohort, they are able to supplement our foundational masterclass content and address specific needs the businesses are facing based on what their businesses are, what they are building, what challenges the businesses are facing, and what insight the companies can benefit from in real time.

* Mentors for Techstars’ programs operate with a “give first” mentality and are volunteers.

* Techstars will be open to engaging with the Cardano community to consider and include any blockchain specific, developer language specific, or community specific mentor from the Cardano community to add to our mentor pool list.

3. The Techstars team will monitor attendance and mentor engagement in the following way:

• Attendance for curriculum sessions (masterclasses and pitch practices) is observed and recorded. Our goal is that each company would attend at least 70% of masterclass sessions.

• The mentor deck administrative account is checked on a weekly basis starting in week 2 to ascertain how many companies are booking mentor meetings/office hours. Our goal is that each company would be booking mentor meetings/office hours on a weekly basis. The team is also on the lookout for any mentor reviews of consequence (as a reminder founders are given the opportunity to rate and make comments on mentor meetings, but are not required to do so).

Note:

A company is counted as “in attendance” as long as at least one representative of the company is present and or consuming the masterclass content.

The attendance percentage goal is arbitrary. We aim for high participation, but recognize that early-stage founders have demanding schedules and occasional drop-offs are expected due to unforeseen events, pitch competition opportunities, meetings with clients, or potential investor meetings during the program. Similarly, the amount of mentor meetings/office hours that are beneficial for a company to book may fluctuate depending on their development stage during the program.

description:
There will be at least two workshops for students and youth and at least four workshops for the general public.

General Public Workshops: These workshops are mainly intended for existing community members. It is assumed that community members are already interested in Cardano and have some basic knowledge about it. By offering this workshop to them, we can increase the number of enthusiasts. Increasing the number of enthusiasts is very important for the future of the community. The "Present and Future of Cardano" created by the fans will be compiled into a document that can be used to appeal to companies, local governments, and others.

Workshops for students and young people: Workshops for young people who have little prior knowledge of Cardano, but are interested in new technology and business. Passing it on to a new generation will bring a breath of fresh air to the community and help revitalize it. The goal is to bring Cardano to a wider audience of young people, as the university students who took my WEB3 course see the potential of Cardano and want to help with this project.

The topics to be covered in the workshop itself will be finalized at Milestone 1. Mainly we will cover Cardano's vision, features, potential, activities, social implementation, representative projects, Intersect, etc.

The results will be made available via the website and Twitter (X) .

acceptance_criteria:
Successful development and testing of API integration:

  • The plugin must connect to the NMKR API and fetch NFT project/token data from both Cardano and Solana blockchains.
  • Data must be stored accurately in the local database tables.

Functional admin dashboard:

  • The dashboard must display synchronization progress and API connection status.
  • Sync must be triggerable via a "Sync Data" button.

Verified blockchain compatibility:

  • Testing results must demonstrate successful API communication and data fetching for both Cardano and Solana.
  • Performance benchmarks: API response time should be <1 second per request under normal conditions.

Verified front-end functionality:

  • The shortcode must display NFT project/token data as specified in the proposal.
  • Responsive design for front-end elements must be tested on various screen sizes.

Confirmed technical requirements:

  • The plugin must run smoothly on WordPress v5.8 and higher, and PHP v7.4 and higher, with no critical compatibility issues.
description:
Development of the core WordPress plugin structure, including:

  • API Integration: Establish connection to NMKR API for fetching NFT project and token data, with explicit support for both Cardano and Solana blockchains.
  • Database Schema: Implementation of custom database tables to store NFT project and token information locally.
  • Dashboard Interface: Creation of an admin dashboard to display sync status, API connection, and basic NFT project/token details.

Synchronization Functionality:

  • Development of a sync mechanism to fetch and store NMKR data locally.
  • Real-time progress updates via a progress bar in the dashboard.
  • Error handling and logging system to ensure smooth synchronization.

Blockchain Compatibility Testing:

  • Conduct tests for compatibility with both Cardano and Solana blockchain APIs to ensure accurate data retrieval and integration.
  • Include performance benchmarks for API calls to ensure data is fetched within acceptable response times (<1 second per request under normal network conditions).

Basic Front-End Display:

  • Implementation of a shortcode to display NFT project/token information on the front-end of the website.
  • Styling and responsiveness for basic display elements.

Technical Requirements:

  • Define and ensure compatibility with minimum WordPress (v5.8) and PHP (v7.4) version requirements.
  • Test the plugin on the latest WordPress and PHP versions for forward compatibility.
title: Development and Deployment of the NMKR Connect Plugin Core Features

acceptance_criteria:

  • Administrators must be able to control plugin feature access by user role.
  • Licensing system must successfully differentiate Free and Premium users.

Verified Analytics Functionality:

  • Analytics features must track and display metrics for sync performance, NFT activity, and user engagement accurately.
  • Metrics collected must align with the original NFT project and token data.

Improved User Interface:

  • The admin dashboard must include filters and improved navigation options.
  • Front-end shortcodes must pass responsive design tests on common screen resolutions.

Cross-chain Testing Results:

  • Advanced features must function correctly for both Cardano and Solana NFTs.
  • Stress tests must confirm API sync performance under heavy cross-chain requests.
description:

  • User Role Customization: Allow administrators to control access to plugin features based on user roles.
  • Licensing Mechanism: Implement a tiered licensing system with Free and Premium tiers:
  • Free Tier: Includes basic NFT display functionality (e.g., list and single view shortcodes) and sync capabilities.
  • Premium Tier: Grants access to advanced shortcodes (carousel view, additional customization options), analytics, and user role management.

Analytics Features:

  • Add advanced styling and responsiveness options for all shortcodes to improve user experience on various devices.

Cross-chain Feature Testing:

  • Ensure all premium features (e.g., advanced shortcodes, analytics) work seamlessly for NFTs from both Cardano and Solana blockchains.
  • Conduct stress testing for API sync functionality to handle cross-chain data requests.
